story_title: Barley Yield Analysis: Varieties, Sites, and Temporal Trends
story_subtitle: Insights into yield performance across different barley varieties, sites, and years (1931-1932)

story_pieces.narration: The 'Trebi' variety consistently outperformed others with an average yield of 42.7 units in 1931 and 38.6 units in 1932, while 'No. 475' showed the lowest average yields of 26.6 units in 1931 and 27.4 units in 1932.
story_pieces.question: Which barley varieties had the highest and lowest average yields across the two years, and how did their performance change over time?
story_pieces.visualization: grouped bar chart (variety vs. average yield by year)

story_pieces.narration: Site 'Waseca' recorded the highest yields for most varieties in 1931, with averages ranging from 50.2 units (Velvet) to 63.8 units (Trebi), while 'Grand Rapids' consistently had the lowest yields for most varieties.
story_pieces.question: Which sites showed the most significant differences in yield performance across barley varieties?
story_pieces.visualization: grouped bar chart (site vs. average yield by variety)

story_pieces.narration: Yields for most varieties increased between 1931 and 1932, with 'Glabron' showing the most substantial improvement (+8.8 units) and 'No. 457' experiencing a decline (-4.5 units).
story_pieces.question: How did yield performance change for each variety between 1931 and 1932?
story_pieces.visualization: line chart (year vs. yield by variety)

story_pieces.narration: Site 'Waseca' consistently produced the highest yields across all varieties, while 'Grand Rapids' had the lowest yields in both years, highlighting site-specific environmental impacts.
story_pieces.question: Which sites were most and least favorable for barley yield across all varieties?
story_pieces.visualization: bar chart (site vs. maximum and minimum yields)

story_pieces.narration: Yield variability across sites was most pronounced for 'Trebi', with a 23.7-unit range (29.7-53.4 units) in 1932, compared to 'No. 475' which showed the least variability (a 6.6-unit range) in 1931.
story_pieces.question: How did yield variability across sites differ among barley varieties, and what does this imply about environmental adaptability?
story_pieces.visualization: box plot (variety vs. yield distribution by site)
